title: ÆTHER: humming layer for Sway v5 take 2
story: A fresh, breezy morning: the same six-part journey and steady 6/8 sway Jithesh liked in First Love v7, now as a refreshing track, not a romance.

brief.notes: A cappella wordless humming layer to mix under v5 take 2 (A major, 120 BPM). Long held, simple notes on the A major home chord so it sits on any chord in the track. Jithesh 09:35.

prompt: A cappella only: NO instruments, no drums, no music bed at all, only voices. A soft, breathy, close wordless female hum (mmm, then open aah), warm and tender, with a soft male hum underneath in harmony. A major, exactly 120 BPM, steady time from the first second. Simple, long, held notes that float slowly: mostly A, C sharp and E, gentle slides between them with light Carnatic gamakam, each phrase four bars long with a soft breath between phrases. Natural, dry, intimate studio recording, no echo, no reverb tail, no effects, no words, no lyrics, no percussion, no beatbox.
